tagline.en_US: An open smart home platform that connects devices and services through adapters, automation and visualizations. Its one persistent data directory allows the service to start before any hardware adapters are configured.

description.en_US: ioBroker is an open smart home platform designed to integrate diverse devices and services. It connects hardware and online systems using a modular adapter architecture, enabling centralized automation and custom visualization dashboards. Users can unify fragmented IoT ecosystems and control home automation logic from a single interface.
